title: Payment API p95 Latency
description: The payment processing endpoint must respond within 200ms at the 95th percentile under peak load.
business_justification: Slow payment processing causes cart abandonment and revenue loss.
measurement_method: Load test with k6 at 5000 RPS for 1 hour, measure p95 from APM.
acceptance_criteria: p95 < 200ms for 99% of 5-minute windows over 1 hour test duration.
validation_method: Automated load test in staging environment.

title: Payment API Availability
description: The payment API must be available 99.99% of the time measured monthly.
business_justification: Payment outage causes immediate revenue loss and customer trust damage.
measurement_method: Synthetic monitoring every 30 seconds from 3 regions, calculated monthly.
acceptance_criteria: Monthly uptime >= 99.99% with error budget tracking.

title: No Hardcoded Secrets
description: No secrets (API keys, passwords, tokens) may be hardcoded in source code.
business_justification: Hardcoded secrets can lead to credential theft and unauthorized access.
measurement_method: Secret scanning with TruffleHog and manual code review.
acceptance_criteria: Zero secrets detected in source code by automated and manual review.
validation_method: Automated secret scan in CI + manual review.

title: Payment Idempotency
description: Payment processing must be idempotent — retrying the same payment request must not produce duplicate charges.
business_justification: Duplicate charges cause customer disputes, chargebacks, and trust loss.
measurement_method: Integration test with duplicate idempotency keys.
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate requests with same idempotency key return original result without duplicate side effects.

title: Disaster Recovery RTO/RPO
description: The payment system must recover from a regional outage within 15 minutes with zero data loss.
business_justification: Extended payment outage causes significant revenue loss and customer churn.
measurement_method: DR drill with regional failover, measured end-to-end.
acceptance_criteria: System fully operational in secondary region within 15 minutes with no data loss.
validation_method: Quarterly DR drill with documented results.

title: Correlation IDs
description: All requests must propagate correlation IDs across service boundaries for tracing.
business_justification: Without correlation IDs, incident diagnosis is slow and cross-service issues are hard to trace.
measurement_method: APM trace analysis and log inspection.
acceptance_criteria: All inter-service calls carry and propagate correlation IDs.
validation_method: APM trace review and log inspection.

title: Dependency Scanning
description: All dependencies must be scanned for known vulnerabilities with zero critical CVEs in production.
business_justification: Vulnerable dependencies can be exploited to compromise the payment system.
measurement_method: Trivy and npm audit in CI pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Zero critical or high CVEs in production dependencies.
